base=$("$HORIZON_GIT" rev-parse HEAD)
idx=$(mktemp /tmp/rev2-ajcr-index.XXXXXX)
trap '"'rm -f \""'$idx"'"' EXIT
GIT_INDEX_FILE=\""'$idx" "$HORIZON_GIT" read-tree "$base"
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" "$HORIZON_GIT" add -- ../../.archon-horizon/inbox/local/items/I-1836.yaml ../../.archon-horizon/inbox/local/history/I-1836.jsonl
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" "$HORIZON_GIT" diff --cached --name-status

tree=$(GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" "$HORIZON_GIT" write-tree)
parent_now=$("$HORIZON_GIT" rev-parse HEAD)
test "$parent_now" = "$base"
commit=$(printf '"'%s\\n' \"chore(review): require Pic0 board owner cleanup\" | \""'$HORIZON_GIT" commit-tree "$tree" -p "$base")
"$HORIZON_GIT" update-ref refs/heads/main "$commit" "$base"
"$HORIZON_GIT" show --stat --oneline --summary "$commit"
"$HORIZON_GIT" diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-status -r "$commit"
for path in .archon-horizon/inbox/local/items/I-1836.yaml .archon-horizon/inbox/local/history/I-1836.jsonl

  commit_blob=$("$HORIZON_GIT" rev-parse "$commit:$path")
  disk_blob=$("$HORIZON_GIT" hash-object "../../$path")
  test "$commit_blob" = "$disk_blob"
  printf '"'%s %s\\n' \""'$path" "$commit_blob"
done'
